feedTitle: Isle of Man 5 day weather forecast

items.title: 5 day forecast updated as of 21 May 2026 6:25am
items.description:
##Today##

Rain and drizzle at first mostly dying out in the morning. Then sunshine over many western and northern parts, but central and southern areas will stay cloudy and rather misty with drizzle over hills then more widely later in afternoon. Dry and bright in all parts in evening, dry overnight.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 12°C and max. air temperature 17°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

0-2


##Wind Speed##

18


##Wind Direction##

S


##Wind##

South or SW 15-20, 20-25 in a few places. Backing South or SE 10-15 during evening/ early part of night, veering South or SW 10-15 later in night, 15-20 in places.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, occasionally poor in mist. Extensive hill fog for much of the time.


##Comments##

Strong winds in places until later.


##Tomorrow##

Dry with sunny spells in places, especially in the north, but always a risk of mist and low cloud around central and southern coasts and hills. Patchy light rain for a time overnight.
